digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration for developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates must resolve their model classes to Bedrock inference profiles and execute end-to-end with parseable verdicts before the production cutover switches the shared bot to Bedrock with no fallback.
Provider-clean execution requires zero direct-Anthropic calls and all invocations must resolve to Bedrock inference profiles, verifiable via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call tally.
Prompt caching must actively engage on the Bedrock path, demonstrated by nonzero cache_read_tokens across multiple gate runs (not write-only, which would be equivalent to bug f81d).
All three gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must execute on Bedrock with valid structured output verdicts and no provider-shaped degradation or fallback to unparsed shapes.
Configuration change must be reversible in one step via environment variable, with revert from Bedrock to Anthropic proven by execution, and no modifications to infra/ directory permitted.
